top_signals.title: Destinus’ monthly output tops Europe’s pre-war annual cruise missile production
top_signals.summary: Defence startup Destinus says it has built more than 1,750 Ruta cruise missiles in Europe and now produces more cruise missiles in a month than Europe did in a year before Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: HYPE surges 15% as NYSE parent ICE moves to bring Hyperliquid perps to US
top_signals.summary: NYSE parent ICE will partner with and invest in Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated, Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures in the U.S.
